description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Hunupolagama, Galnewa D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - (25/0264)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a formal declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title to a specific parcel of land, including detailed land particulars such as parcel number, extent, location, and ownership details. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category as it primarily concerns land registration, title settlement, and property ownership matters.
